headline: Emerson (EMR) Launches Refinery Software That Could Matter For Automation Growth
summary: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) has introduced new software solutions that automate key refinery workflows, including crude scheduling and product blending. The products are designed to streamline complex, margin-critical processes and support faster responses to changes in refinery operations. This launch marks a material update in Emerson Electric's process automation offering for refinery customers.
